fields.Description:
PUBLISHED SPECIFICATION, read live 27 Oct 2026 from the supplier's own product page and collection (products.json). 4–6 people; exterior 2.5m W × 2.2m D × 2.4m H; Harvia Cilindro BlackSteel 10.8kW electric heater with digital controls; fully insulated walls and ceiling with foil vapour barrier; Finnish Thermowood; two-tier floating Black Alder benches; large panoramic window; toughened-glass door; Douglas Fir exterior in black Tikkurila Opaque; steel-clad roof; LED lighting; ventilation; thermometer, hygrometer and sand timer.
PRICE: introductory price including VAT until 30 November 2026 (see Product Pricing). Made to order; contact to order (no online cart); 50% deposit; delivery additional, quoted by location.
ORIGIN: "Handcrafted to order in Connemara, Galway" (product page) / "designed and built by Irish Sauna Company in Connemara" (collection page). The heater is manufactured by Harvia; PlotNua must not imply every component is made in Ireland.
NOT PUBLISHED BY PLOTNUA: interior approx. 2.3m × 2.0m 'subject to construction drawings' — not published by PlotNua.
NOT PUBLISHED, not inferred: delivery cost, warranty terms, installation responsibility, planning position. Production time ('generally 2–3 weeks from receipt of deposit') is recorded here and is NOT published as a lead time.
